verdict.rationale: Postman documents an SDK Generator that creates client SDKs from Collections and API specs, and a Postman API for programmatic access to its own platform, giving developers assets to build against — but there is no evidence of an official first-party SDK library set (e.g., versioned Node/Python/Go client libraries) explicitly meant for AI-native developers to import and code against. missing for 10: dedicated official SDK packages/libraries for the Postman API itself, language-specific SDK docs, and independent confirmation of SDK reliability/quality.
